title: GI 201 – Operational, Financial, Regulatory and Legal

topics.title: General Insurance Company Operations
topics.objective: The candidate will understand the structure and functions of a general insurance company.

outcomes.text: Describe the various core and supporting functions of a general insurance company.
Differentiate among the various classifications of insurers.
Describe the marketing and distribution of general insurance products.
Understand the processes for underwriting and pricing general insurance policies.
Describe the activities and challenges in the claim handling process.
Describe the goals of insurer risk control activities.
Explain why premium audits are conducted.
Demonstrate knowledge of general insurance risks, perils, product characteristics / issues, and contracts.
Describe and compare the different types of reinsurance and risk mitigation instruments.
Demonstrate knowledge of the issues regarding international business for insurance companies.

resources.citation: General Insurance Company Operations, SOA, May 2025
Fundamentals of General Insurance Actuarial Analysis, Friedland, J., 2nd Edition, 2022
IAA Risk Book: Non-Life Perils and Coverages, Insurance Regulation Committee, International Actuarial Association, May 2023, sections 3-7, and 8.1-8.2

Excerpts from Business Law for Insurance Professionals, Assignment 3, pp. 3.29-3.39 (begin on pp. 3.29 with “Financial Considerations in International Business”)

topics.title: Regulatory Environment
topics.objective: The candidate will understand the regulatory environment for general insurance.

outcomes.text: Describe the functions and goals of the different forms of insurance regulation.
Describe the protections provided by solvency and insolvency regulation.
Understand the issue of discrimination and insurance.
Discuss the issues regarding usage-based insurance and telematics in automobile insurance.
Describe the development of general insurance programs controlled by government or collective insurance industry organizations and their mechanisms of operation.
Discuss the issues with the use of credit scores by insurers.
Understand the function and regulation of price optimization.
Outline the function and regulation of captives.
Understand the functions and regulatory environment for reinsurance.

topics.title: Legal Environment
topics.objective: The candidate will understand tort law and insurance law with respect to general insurance.

outcomes.text: Describe and interpret the key elements of tort law and the underlying principles of insurance law.
Discuss the issues of tort trends and tort reform as it applies to the general insurance industry.
Understand the effects of transnational tort litigation.
Understand mass torts/class action suits and discuss their effect on the general insurance industry.
Understand the use of no-fault insurance.
Understand the international legal environment as it relates to general insurance.
Discuss the influence of the U.S. tort law environment in other countries.
Discuss the issue of social inflation and its effect on general insurance.
Describe and interpret legal cases/issues included in the syllabus resources.

topics.title: Financial Economics
topics.objective: The candidate will understand elements of financial economics relevant to general insurance.

outcomes.text: Demonstrate knowledge of behavioral finance.
Demonstrate knowledge of asset liability management strategies for general insurance companies.
Calculate an underwriting profit margin using different models under a financial economics approach.

resources.citation: Behavioral Finance, J. Ritter, Pacific-Basin Finance Journal, Volume 11, Issue 4, Sep 2003, sections 1-3 (pp. 429-434)

topics.title: Financial Reporting
topics.objective: The candidate will understand elements of financial reporting for general insurance companies.

outcomes.text: Demonstrate knowledge of the different types of general insurance liabilities.
Understand and apply the concepts of insurance/reinsurance accounting.
Understand the different financial reporting standards for general insurers.
Understand key terms and considerations related to claim liabilities.
Understand the reporting of financial instruments.

topics.title: Financial Health Measurement
topics.objective: The candidate will understand the analysis of a general insurer’s financial health.

outcomes.text: Understand the various considerations for performance measurement of a general insurer.
Understand and apply financial health ratios.
Demonstrate knowledge of solvency monitoring for general insurance companies.
Understand and apply the EU Solvency II capital requirement.
Demonstrate knowledge of ORSA.
Discuss the function of credit rating agencies and their influence on general insurers.

topics.title: Responsibilities of the Actuary
topics.objective: The candidate will understand the standards of practice and professionalism required of the actuary.

outcomes.text: Describe, interpret and apply professionalism principles as defined by the International Actuarial Association (IAA).
Describe, interpret and apply Standards of Practice as defined by the IAA.
Demonstrate knowledge of the general insurance actuarial opinion and the role of the appointed actuary.
Describe and apply the concept of materiality.
